source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 33 exercise hal (PDF 260-261): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed aur descriptive jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 33 (Water) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)
1. Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: “each questions” ki jagah “each question” hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
I. Which property of water is primarily responsible for its ability to resist rapid temperature changes in large aquatic ecosystems?
(Paani ki kaun si khasiyat bare aabi nizamon ko temperature ki tez tabdeeli se bachati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonding paani ko zyada specific heat capacity (aur heat of vaporisation) deti hai, is liye bare aabi zakheere thermal tor par mustahkam rehte hain aur temperature ki tez tabdeeli rokte hain (33.1). Dipole hydrogen bonding ki wajah hai, magar temperature rokne wali khasiyat zyada specific heat hai.

blocks.prompt:
II. A water sample is found to have a very high Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD). What does this most likely indicate about the water body?
(Paani ke namoone ka BOD bohat zyada hai. Is se paani ke bare mein kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: High concentration of nitrates and phosphates.

blocks.explanation: BOD woh oxygen hai jo microorganisms ko organic maadde torne ke liye chahiye; zyada BOD ka matlab bohat organic maadda, yani shadeed organic aaloodgi, jo dissolved oxygen khatam karti hai (33.1).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which of the following best describes the formation of a "pollution plume"?
("Pollution plume" banne ki behtareen wazahat kaun si hai?)

options.text: The mixture of hydrocarbons and road salts

blocks.explanation: Pollution plume tab banta hai jab point source aik hi jagah par kharij kare, maslan factory ka pipe darya mein lead ya mercury salts daale; concentration nikaas par sab se zyada hota hai (33.2). Runoff aur road-salt mixtures phaile hue non-point sources hain.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Why is Non-Point Source (NPS) pollution considered "weather-dependent" compared to Point Source pollution?
(Non-Point Source (NPS) pollution ko point source ke muqable mein "mausam par munhasir" kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: NPS pollutants are only toxic when the temperature of the water rises.
NPS pollution requires precipitation to wash diffuse surface contaminants into water bodies.
Point sources only discharge waste during specific industrial seasons.
Rainfall neutralizes the localized acute toxicity of point source plumes.

blocks.explanation: NPS pollution tab hoti hai jab barish ya pighalti barf zameen par aur us ke andar se behti hai, aaloodgi utha kar paani tak le jati hai; is liye yeh tez toofan jaise mausami waqiaat par munhasir hai (33.2).

blocks.prompt:
V. Bacteria in aquatic sediments convert inorganic mercury into methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺). Which statement best explains why this conversion increases the ecological hazard?
(Bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) mein badalte hain. Yeh tabdeeli khatra kyun barhati hai?)

options.text: Methylmercury dissolves more readily in the water
Methyl mercury is biodegradable and enters nutrient cycle.
Methylmercury is a solid that clogs the gills of fish.

blocks.explanation: Methylmercury charbi mein bohat hal hone wala (fat-soluble) hai, is liye aasani se biological membranes (aur blood-brain barrier) paar karta aur food chain mein barhta (biomagnification) hai; yeh taqatwar neurotoxin (aasaab ka zehar) hai (33.3).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Which condition is a direct result of Cadmium (Cd) replacing Calcium (Ca) in the skeletal system?
(Haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah cadmium aane se kaun si bimari hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lambe arse tak cadmium lene se Itai-itai bimari hoti hai: Cd haddiyon mein Ca ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura kar deta hai (33.3). Minamata mercury se, blue baby nitrate se, chloracne PCBs se.

blocks.prompt:
VII. What is the primary chemical role of Aluminium Sulphate (Al₂(SO₄)₃) in the wastewater treatment process?
(Wastewater treatment mein aluminium sulphate (Al₂(SO₄)₃) ka asal kaam kya hai?)

options.text: To act as a semi-permeable membrane.

blocks.explanation: Al₂(SO₄)₃ coagulant hai: yeh baareek colloidal zarraat ko jor kar bare gucchhe (floc) banata hai jo baith kar nikal jaate hain (33.6).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Ion exchange technology "softens" water by replacing calcium (Ca²⁺) and magnesium (Mg²⁺) ions with:
(Ion exchange paani ko narm karne ke liye Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ko kin ions se badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ion-exchange column mein sakhti wale ions Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ Na⁺ ya H⁺ ions se badal diye jaate hain (33.6).

blocks.prompt:
a) Differentiate between Point Source and Non-Point Source pollution in terms of the "concentration" of pollutants at the site of entry.
Point source aur non-point source pollution mein dakhle ki jagah par pollutants ke concentration ka farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Point source murtakiz (concentrated) aur maqami tor par shadeed; NPS phaili hui aur wasee.

rows: Aik hi pehchani jagah se dakhil
Wasee ilaqe mein bohat jagahon se dakhil
Nikaas par concentration sab se zyada (pollution plume)
Kam concentration par pollutants ka mixture
Maqami shadeed zehreela pan
Kahin zyada bare ilaqe mein phaili

blocks.prompt:
b) Using an example from the text, explain how an underground storage tank can become a point source of pollution.
Text ki misal se batayein ke zer-e-zameen storage tank point source kaise ban sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Chemical plant ka storage tank apna maadda mitti mein aur phir zer-e-zameen paani (groundwater) mein risa sakta hai. Risaao aik hi pehchani jagah (tank) se hai, is liye yeh point source hai aur tank ke qareeb concentration sab se zyada hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Identify two types of chemical pollutants commonly found in urban storm water runoff.
Shehri barish ke behte paani mein aam do chemical pollutants batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Sarkon aur parkings par giray engine oil ke hydrocarbons.
2. Tyres se zinc (aur road salts).

blocks.prompt:
d) Differentiate between the "solubility" of pesticides like DDT and inorganic nutrients like nitrates in the context of the water cycle.
Water cycle ke hawale se DDT jaise pesticides aur nitrates jaise inorganic nutrients ki hal pazeeri (solubility) ka farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nitrates paani ke saath behte hain; DDT jaandaron ke tissues mein ja kar jama hota hai.

rows: Non-polar, paani mein hal nahi
Ionic, polar paani mein bohat hal
Machhli aur parindon ki charbi mein bohat hal
Hal ho kar runoff aur groundwater ke saath safar
Der tak rehte aur jama hote hain (POPs)
Eutrophication; peene ke paani mein blue baby syndrome

blocks.prompt:
e) Explain why microplastics are considered a "growing environmental crisis" differently than organic solid waste.
Microplastics organic solid waste se mukhtalif tor par "barhta mahauliyati bohran" kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Organic waste gal sar kar khatam (biodegrade) ho jata hai, magar plastic nahi; yeh sirf chhote zarraat (microplastics) mein toot-ta hai jo sadiyon tak rehte hain. Janwar inhein kha lete hain, yeh food chain mein aa chuke hain aur insaani sehat ke liye fikr ka baais hain.

blocks.prompt:
f) How an oil spill physically disrupts the chemical balance of a marine ecosystem?
Tail ka phailao (oil spill) samundari nizam ka chemical tawazun kaise bigaarta hai?
blocks.explanation: Gira hua tail paani ki satah par tah ban kar phailta hai jo dhoop rokti (photosynthesis kam) aur hawa se oxygen ka tabadla kam karti hai, yani dissolved oxygen ghat jati hai. Is ke zehreele hydrocarbons machhliyon, parindon aur mammals ko nuqsan aur mangroves, coral reefs aur sahilon ko tabah karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
g) Why are synthetic organic pollutants, like PCBs and pesticides, considered "persistent" in the environment?
PCBs aur pesticides jaise synthetic organic pollutants mahaul mein "persistent" kyun kehlate hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh biodegradable nahi (gal sar kar khatam nahi hote), is liye mahaul mein der tak rehte hain (persistent organic pollutants, POPs, maslan DDT). Non-polar aur charbi mein hal hone ki wajah se fatty tissues mein jama ho kar food chain mein barhte hain (bioaccumulation).

blocks.prompt:
h) How do the decomposition of organic matter in polluted water contributes to global warming?
Aaloodah paani mein organic maadde ka galna sarna global warming kaise barhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sewage aur runoff algae aur doosre jaandaron ki barhotri barhate hain. Jab yeh mar kar kam oxygen wale (anaerobic) paani mein galte hain to methane, aik taqatwar greenhouse gas, nikalti hai jo global warming aur climate change barhati hai.

blocks.prompt:
i) Name four methods used for water conservation.
Paani bachane ke chaar tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Zaraat mein drip aur sprinkler irrigation.
2. Greywater (dhulai, bartan, nahane ka paani) dobara istemal.
3. Barish ka paani jama karna (rainwater harvesting).
4. Supply lines ke leak theek karna (chhote dams aur recharge wells bhi).

blocks.prompt:
j) What is the role of "industrial discharge" in water pollution?
Paani ki aaloodgi mein "industrial discharge" ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sanatein paani ki aaloodgi ka bara zariya hain: factories (refineries, chemical plants, tanneries, fertilizer aur automobile sanatein) nuqsandeh chemicals, heavy metals (Pb, Hg, Cd) aur zehreela fuzla seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samundaron mein daalti hain, aam tor par point source ke tor par aur zyada COD ke saath.

blocks.prompt:
k) Both reverse osmosis (RO) and ion exchange methods are used to obtain high-purity water?
a) Differentiate between the processes involved in both these methods.
b) What impurities do these methods target?
RO aur ion exchange dono khalis paani ke liye hain. a) Dono ke processes ka farq; b) yeh kin impurities ko nishana banate hain?
blocks.explanation:
a) Table dekhein.
b) RO: hal shuda namak, bacteria aur doosri milawat (maslan zyada namkeen paani mein). Ion exchange: sakhti wale ions Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ (paani narm karna).

rows: Pressure se paani semi-permeable membrane mein se guzara jata hai
Paani ion-exchange column mein se guzara jata hai
Membrane impurities ko rok leti hai
Ghair matlooba ions Na⁺ ya H⁺ se badal jaate hain
Hal shuda namak, bacteria aur doosri milawat nikalti hai
Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ nikalte hain (paani narm)

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Explain the relationship between acid rain and the presence of toxic heavy metals in aquatic environments.
Acid rain aur aabi mahaul mein zehreeli heavy metals ki mojoodgi ka talluq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Acid rain tab banti hai jab sulphur dioxide (SO₂) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) barish mein hal ho kar H₂SO₄ aur HNO₃ banate hain; is se jheelon aur daryaon mein hydronium ions (H₃O⁺) barh jaate hain.
2. Yeh izafi tezabiyat zehreeli heavy metal compounds, maslan aluminium hydroxide aur lead salts, ko teh (sediments) se paani mein le aati hai: protonation se un ki hal pazeeri barha kar ya unhein mineral satah se hata kar, maslan
Al(OH)₃(s) + 3H₃O⁺(aq) → Al³⁺(aq) + 6H₂O(l)
3. Acid rain mitti se bhi Al³⁺ nikalti hai jo beh kar jheelon mein jata hai.
4. Hal shuda metal ions zehreele hain: Al³⁺ machhli ke gills band kar deta hai aur machhli dam ghutne se marti hai; lead aur doosri dhaatein jaandaron mein jama ho kar food chain mein ooper jaati hain (bioaccumulation).
Yani pH jitna kam, utni zyada zehreeli dhaat paani mein hal aur aabi zindagi ko utna zyada nuqsan.

blocks.prompt:
b) Analyze the environmental impact of agricultural runoff as a Non-Point Source of pollution. Reference specific chemicals in your answer.
Zaraati runoff ke non-point source ke tor par mahauliyati asraat ka tajziya karein; khaas chemicals ka hawala dein.
blocks.explanation:
Zaraati runoff non-point source hai: barish hazaron hectare kheton se chemicals daryaon mein le jati hai, is liye aaloodgi phaili hui, mausam par munhasir aur aik jagah se qaboo karna mushkil hai.
1. Fertilizers: ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃), nitrates (NO₃⁻) aur phosphates (PO₄³⁻) eutrophication karte hain: algae ki bharmaar dhoop rokti hai; marne aur galne par oxygen khatam karti hai aur hypoxic "dead zones" bante hain jahan machhliyan marti hain; biodiversity aur fisheries ko nuqsan.
2. Peene ke paani mein zyada nitrate bachon mein Blue Baby Syndrome (methaemoglobinaemia) karta hai.
3. Pesticides aur herbicides: DDT non-polar aur charbi mein hal, der tak rehta (POP) aur machhli aur parindon mein jama hota hai (patle ande ke chhilke, nasl ka rukna); pesticides hormones bigaarte (endocrine disruptors) hain. Glyphosate runoff mein aam herbicide hai.
4. Phosphate fertilizer ki milawat se cadmium food chain mein jama hota hai (Itai-itai bimari).
5. Ghalat irrigation se mitti ka kataao: sediments daryaon ko gadla aur band karte aur makaan (habitats) bigaarte hain.
6. Galta sarta organic maadda methane chhorta hai jo global warming barhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Evaluate the role of agricultural runoff" in contributing to different types of water pollution.
Mukhtalif qism ki aabi aaloodgi mein zaraati runoff ke kirdar ka jaiza lein.
blocks.explanation:
Zaraati runoff chapter mein bayan ki gayi taqreeban har qism ki aabi aaloodgi mein hissa daalta hai:
1. Nutrient pollution (eutrophication): fertilizers ki izafi nitrogen aur phosphorus → algae ki bharmaar, kam DO, dead zones; peene ke paani mein nitrates → Blue Baby Syndrome.
2. Chemical pollution: pesticides aur herbicides (DDT, glyphosate) → der tak rehna, bioaccumulation, hormones ki kharabi; phosphate fertilizers se cadmium → heavy metal aaloodgi.
3. Microbiological pollution: kheton ka runoff janwaron ka fuzla aur us ke bacteria, virus aur parasites laata hai → paani se phailne wali bimariyan.
4. Sediment pollution: ghalat irrigation se mitti ka kataao paani ko gadla aur raaste band karta aur habitats bigaarta hai.
5. Groundwater pollution: kheton ki drainage satah aur zer-e-zameen dono paani aaloodah karti hai.
Jaiza: yeh non-point source hai jo bohat bare ilaqe par phaila aur barish se chalta hai, is liye bara aur mushkil se qaboo hone wala zariya hai; ise pipe ke aakhir par treatment ke bajaye fertilizer aur pesticide ke soch samajh kar istemal, crop rotation aur behtar (drip/sprinkler) irrigation se kam kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein aik faltu band karne wala quotation mark chhapa hai: “agricultural runoff"” ka shuru wala quote nahi; durust “agricultural runoff” hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Evaluate the benefits and the long-term chemical risks involved in the use of chlorine as a disinfectant.
Chlorine ko disinfectant ke tor par istemal karne ke faide aur lambe arse ke chemical khatrat ka jaiza lein.
blocks.explanation:
Faide:
1. Chlorination disinfection ka sab se aam tareeqa hai; sirf filtration baareek bimari phailane wale jaraseem (pathogens) nahi nikal sakti.
2. Chlorine gas ya sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) paani mein hypochlorous acid banate hain: Cl₂ + H₂O → HOCl + HCl. HOCl bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus kar un ke kaam bigaar deta aur unhein maar deta hai.
3. Is se cholera, typhoid, dysentery aur hepatitis A jaisi paani se phailne wali bimariyan rukti hain.
4. Yeh sasta, aasan hai aur paani mein thori chlorine chhorta hai jo supply pipes mein bhi hifazat karti hai (chapter se aage).
Lambe arse ke chemical khatrat (chapter se aage):
1. Chlorine paani ke qudrati organic maadde se mil kar disinfection by-products, maslan trihalomethanes (jaise chloroform, CHCl₃), banati hai; in mein se kuch lambe arse tak lene par cancer ka shubha rakhte hain.
2. Zyada chlorine se zaiqa aur boo kharab hoti hai aur kharij hone par aabi zindagi ko nuqsan hota hai.
3. Chlorine gas khud zehreeli hai, ise hifazat se rakhna aur bartna zaroori hai.
Jaiza: jaan leva bimariyon se bachao ka faida khatrat se kahin zyada hai, magar chlorine ki miqdar qaboo mein rakhni chahiye aur chlorination se pehle organic maadda nikalna chahiye (ya ozone, O₃, ya H₂O₂ jaise mutabadil), taake by-products kam banein.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe the effects of heavy metals and pesticides on the human body.
Heavy metals aur pesticides ke insaani jism par asraat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Heavy metals ka atomic weight aur density zyada hoti hai; biodegradable na hone ki wajah se jaandaron ke tissues mein jama hote hain.
1. Mercury: methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) charbi mein bohat hal, biological membranes aur blood-brain barrier paar karta aur food chain mein barhta (biomagnification) hai. Yeh taqatwar neurotoxin hai; lambe arse tak lene se Minamata bimari (ataxia yani chaal ka bigarna, haathon pairon ka sunn hona, pathon ki kamzori).
2. Lead (Pb²⁺): haemoglobin banne mein rukawat, yani anaemia (khoon ki kami); bachon mein jama hone wala zehar jo na-qabil-e-ilaaj aasabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der karta hai.
3. Cadmium: lambe arse tak lene se Itai-itai bimari (Cd haddiyon mein Ca ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura karta hai) aur gurdon ka shadeed nuqsan (nephrotoxicity).
Pesticides aur herbicides (maslan DDT, glyphosate):
1. Hormones ki kharabi aur nashonuma ke masail se jure hain; kai endocrine disruptors hain jo estrogen jaise qudrati hormones ki naql karte hain, hormonal cancers aur nasl rukne (maslan parindon ke patle chhilke) se jure.
2. Charbi mein hal aur der tak rehne wale hone se jama hote aur food chain mein barhte hain; sab se ooper ke shikari, insaan samet, sab se zyada dose paate hain.
3. PCBs mumkina insaani carcinogens hain, immune system kamzor karte aur chloracne (jild ki bimari) karte hain.
Figure 33.2 ke mazeed asraat: Alzheimer's, dil ka fail hona, phephron ka cancer, jigar ka galna (hepatic necrosis), ovarian cancer, pathon/haddiyon ki bimariyan, thyroid hormone ki kami, khoon ke cells ka toot-na (intravascular haemolysis), ultiyan/dast, gurdon ki kharabi aur osteoporosis.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain the different sources of heavy metals and organic compounds.
Heavy metals aur organic compounds ke mukhtalif zaraye bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Heavy metals aam tor par industrial discharge, mining aur fuzle ke ghalat thikane lagane se paani mein aati hain.
1. Mercury: coal jalana, sone ki kaan kani (gold mining), thermometer ya battery banane ka fuzla; teh (sediments) mein bacteria ise methylmercury bana dete hain.
2. Lead: leaded petrol (ab duniya bhar mein band), purani plumbing (lead pipes; Pb²⁺ zang se paani mein), lead-acid batteries aur paints.
3. Cadmium: metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate fertilizers ki milawat.
4. Pb, Hg aur Cd electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein bhi hain, jahan se groundwater tak pohanchte hain.
5. Paint aur battery factories, tanneries aur chemical plants metal salts seedha daryaon mein daalte hain (point sources).
Organic compounds:
1. Pesticides aur herbicides (DDT, glyphosate): zaraati runoff aur gharelu baghbani.
2. PCBs: electrical transformers mein coolant; khatarnak fuzle ki jagahon se paani mein risaao.
3. Hydrocarbons (tail): jahazon, kashtiyon aur samundari transport se oil spill aur leak; sarkon aur parkings se barish ke saath engine oil; oil refineries.
4. Organic fuzla: bina treatment ya kam treatment wala sewage, janwaron ka fuzla, hospital waste, aur ghar ke detergents, tail aur chemicals jo naliyon mein jaate hain.
5. Plastics: phenki gayi botlein, thailiyan aur machhli ke jaal, jo microplastics mein toot-te hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Describe various technologies used in water treatment.
Paani saaf karne (water treatment) ki mukhtalif technologies bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tareeqa aaloodgi ki qism aur shiddat (organic maadda, chemicals, jaraseem) par munhasir hai. Treatment ke teen darje: primary (physical kachra nikalna), secondary (biological amal) aur tertiary (chemical safai). Ahem technologies:
i. Screening aur sedimentation: paani dhaat ki jaaliyon (screens) se guzar kar bare na-hal zarraat nikalte hain, phir bare tankon mein rok kar latke hue thos gravity se neeche baithte hain.
ii. Coagulation aur flocculation (zaroorat par): aluminium sulphate, Al₂(SO₄)₃, jaisa coagulant baareek colloidal zarraat ko jor kar bare gucchhe (floc) banata hai jo baith jaate hain; hal shuda milawat (heavy metals, phosphates) na-hal shakal mein precipitate hoti hai.
iii. Filtration: paani darja ba darja ret aur bajri ki tahon se guzarta hai jo baareek zarraat aur kuch jaraseem ko suraakhon mein rok leti hain; behtar safai ke liye activated carbon.
iv. Disinfection: filtration hal shuda ions ya baareek jaraseem nahi nikal sakti. Chlorination sab se aam hai; Cl₂ ya NaOCl hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banate hain jo bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus kar un ke kaam bigaar deta hai. Ozone (O₃), kabhi H₂O₂ ke saath, bhi istemal hoti hai.
v. Reverse osmosis (RO) aur ion exchange (bohat khalis paani ke liye, maslan labs ya namkeen ilaqe): RO pressure se paani semi-permeable membrane mein se guzarta hai jo hal shuda namak, bacteria aur doosri milawat rokti hai; ion exchange Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ko Na⁺ ya H⁺ se badal kar sakht paani narm karta hai.
Treatment plant (Figure 33.4): wastewater → coagulation tank (chemical addition) → flocculation tank → sedimentation (sludge nikalna) → filtration → chlorination aur disinfection → saaf paani.

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Explain the difference between DO, BOD, and COD; How they relate to the water pollution?
DO, BOD aur COD ka farq aur un ka paani ki aaloodgi se talluq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
DO (dissolved oxygen): paani mein hal shuda oxygen jo aabi jaandaron ke saans ke liye mojood hai; paani ki quality aur ecosystem ki sehat ka ahem nishan.
BOD (biochemical oxygen demand): woh oxygen jo microorganisms ko paani ka organic maadda torne ke liye mukarrar muddat, aam tor par 5 din 20 °C par, chahiye; yeh organic (gal sar jaane wali) aaloodgi naapta hai.
COD (chemical oxygen demand): woh oxygen jo KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ jaise oxidising agents se paani ke organic aur inorganic maaddon ko chemically oxidise karne mein lagti hai; yeh industrial aur gharelu fuzle samet kul oxidise hone wali aaloodgi naapta hai.
Aaloodgi se talluq:
1. Saaf paani: DO zyada, BOD aur COD kam; aaloodah paani: DO kam, BOD aur COD zyada.
2. Zyada BOD = bohat organic maadda; jaraseem jab ise torte hain to DO khatam hoti hai, hypoxia (oxygen ki kami) se aabi zindagi ko nuqsan.
3. COD aam tor par BOD se zyada hota hai kyunke yeh woh maadde bhi ginta hai jo jaraseem nahi tor sakte.
Aam qeematein (Table 33.1):
Bohat khalis paani: DO 7–10, BOD < 1, COD < 2 mg/L
Peene ka paani: DO > 6, BOD < 2, COD < 5 mg/L
Darmiyana aaloodah: DO 4–6, BOD 2–8, COD 10–20 mg/L
Khaam sewage: DO < 1, BOD 100–400, COD 200–1000 mg/L
Industrial waste: DO 0–2, BOD 500–5000+, COD 1000–20,000+ mg/L

rows: Paani mein hal shuda oxygen
Jaraseem ki organic maadda torne mein lagi oxygen
Chemically oxidise karne mein lagi oxygen (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇)
Zyada = saaf paani
Zyada = shadeed organic aaloodgi
Zyada = kul aaloodgi zyada
Peene ka paani > 6 mg/L
Peene ka paani < 2 mg/L
Peene ka paani < 5 mg/L

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka aasan tareeqa: DO = paani mein kitni oxygen MOJOOD hai (zyada achha). BOD aur COD = paani ki gandagi kitni oxygen KHA JAYEGI (zyada bura). BOD sirf jaraseem (microbes) ka hisaab, COD chemicals se poora hisaab, is liye COD aam tor par BOD se zyada hota hai.
